description:
Future-ready careers start with the right guidance.
With teaching experience in Marine Engineering and Merchant Navy since 2008, and past roles at Samundra Institute of Maritime Studies and Great Eastern Institute of Maritime Studies, I currently mentor students at Tolani Maritime Institute. As an Engineering Counsellor specialised in Merchant Navy careers, I help students choose the right course, college and pathway to high-paying shipboard and shore-based opportunities, with honest, practical advice based on real industry exposure.
